evidence: Stored point is the Rateče settlement centre, not a lift. No source opened says which installation ZAG inspected: zag.si could not be fetched, the 2009 decree on uradni-list.si is blocked for robots, gov.si publishes no register of installations (only passenger totals). The client match is sourced though: the record's client 'Zavod za šport RS Planica' is the body that manages the Planica Nordic Centre, whose only chairlift is the 2009 Leitner lift (Čaplja). The Macesnovc lifts have a different operator (Smuk), which is the client of the other record. So the operator evidence points planica_z to the Nordic Centre chairlift, 2.4 km from the stored point, but this is an inference from client names, not a statement by ZAG. Candidates, with sources. (1) Čaplja chairlift, Planica Nordic Centre: lift-world lists it in place 'Rateče' as 'Planica', 2-CLF, Leitner, 2009, 476 m. nc-planica.si: lower station 'right next to the Bloudek's Ski Jump', upper station 'beside the in-run of the Gorišek Brothers' ski flying hill'. The centre is 'managed by the Sport Institute of the Republic of Slovenia Planica' (ZŠRS Planica, Dunajska 22, Ljubljana). Nearest sourced coordinates: Planica Nordic Centre 46.4758, 13.7240 (Wikipedia), Letalnica 46.476112, 13.722010 (skisprungschanzen.com). No station coordinate found. (2) Macesnovc ski area, Rateče: two-seat chairlift 'Macesnovec', lift-world 2-CLF Doppelmayr 2004, commissioned 14 Jan 2006, 1300 m, 870 to 1200 m, 1100 persons per hour, 'Date of closing down: 2020', plus two short tows for children (sl. Wikipedia text: 120 m and 180 m) and a 'Slatna' 1-SL Graffer 230 m on lift-world. skiresort.com lift operator: 'SMUK', Teslova ulica 30, 1000 Ljubljana. Gorenjski glas 2016: 'Koncesijo za upravljanje smučišča ima podjetje Smuk'. Chairlift base 46.491714, 13.7073 (skiresort.com). (3) 2006 official list: only one Rateče row, 'Lom 1', 2-SED, 1975, operator Športni center Rateče Planica, Teslova 3, Ljubljana, no Planica row and no operator named Smuk.
